item.title: IBM MCGA Gate Array Reverse Engineering
item.description:
📝 The IBM chipset consists of the memory controller gate array and the video formatter gate array. It is a Seiko SLA6330 gate array. Register 0x20 (Reserved) is a manufacturing test mode register.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/schlae/IBM_MCGA
